claims: Ryan Coogler's Sinners won four Academy Awards at the 2026 Oscars.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners received 16 nominations at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners' 16 nominations at the 2026 Oscars were record-breaking.
Sinners won Best Actor for Michael B. Jordan at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners won Best Original Screenplay for Ryan Coogler at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners won Best Cinematography for Autumn Durald Arkapaw at the 2026 Oscars.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win Best Cinematography.
Sinners won Best Original Score for Ludwig Göransson at the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners is a vampire horror story set in the Jim Crow South.
